name: My collaborators can't be this annoying?!: A freaking bad time marooned on an island
source:
As a hotshot foodie influencer, you're taking a boat trip with four others to make content together. Trouble comes when the boat gets run aground on a yet-uninhabited island, and now you're stuck waiting for rescue! People will find and get you soon, right? ...Right?

While you wait, you can get comfortable and get to know the other influencers better. Find out about their past, dig into their secrets, and most importantly, film your content together! The grind never stops, when you're stranded! 

[From [url=https://cetusstudios.itch.io/my-collaborators-cant-be-this-annoying-a-freaking-bad-time-marooned-on-an-island]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为一名炙手可热的美食影响者，你将与其他四人一起乘船旅行，一起制作内容。当船在一个无人居住的岛屿上搁浅时，麻烦就来了，现在你被困在等待救援！人们很快就会找到并抓住你，对吗？…正确的？

在等待的过程中，你可以放松下来并更好地了解其他有影响力的人。了解他们的过去，挖掘他们的秘密，最重要的是，一起拍摄你的内容！当你陷入困境时，磨难永远不会停止！

[来自[url=https://cetusstudios.itch.io/my-collaborators-cant-be-this-annoying-a-freaking-bad-time-marooned-on-an-island]itch.io[/url]]
